proposal.title: Roof Replacement in Denver
proposal.metaDescription: Licensed Denver roof replacement with a limited warranty.
proposal.introduction: Denver hailstorms and freeze-thaw cycles put every roof under storm-damage stress. Homeowners comparing local roofers need clear answers about roof replacement cost drivers, process and trust signals before requesting a quote.

sections.heading: What a full roof replacement includes
sections.body: A full roof replacement covers tear-off, deck inspection, underlayment and shingle installation. Licensed and insured crews handle permits and disposal.

sections.heading: Timeline and process
sections.body: Most replacements finish within days of material delivery. The inspection, scheduling and installation steps are explained before work begins.

sections.heading: Warranty and workmanship
sections.body: Work carries a 25-year limited warranty. Serving Denver since 1998. The crew holds an BBB A+ rating. Licensing and insurance details are provided on request so homeowners can verify trust signals.

proposal.conclusion: Understanding cost drivers and process steps makes comparing roofers straightforward.
proposal.cta: Book a free roof inspection today.
